name: KNN-NeRF
aliases: KNN approach to training NeRF on point cloud
NeRFs trained on point clouds with KNN color assignment
definition: A baseline method for training NeRFs on 3D point clouds by assigning ground truth colors to rays based on the nearest point in the cloud, which fails to reconstruct sharp object borders due to sparsity.
summary: KNN-NeRF trains NeRFs on sparse point clouds by assigning ray colors via nearest neighbor search, serving as a baseline that lacks sharp detail reconstruction.
